newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen opening cautiously, rising.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen opening cautiously, rising.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were expected to turn firmer on Monday though volume was expected to be thin as most investors awaited news of a cabinet reshuffle, brokers said.

Traders say they do not see any reason for the all share to decline, since broking firms have been upgrading earnings per share forecasts for the current accounting year after better than expected profits for the year to March.
"Everyone is waiting for news of the cabinet reshuffle, but the index should rise because there is nothing negative to make it fall," said Ajit Dias Wanigasekera of Ceylinco Stock Brokers.
